e.title: **一份文件写明「两份基线冲突时谁赢」，并禁止发明业务规则**：一个商业财险语义系统**逐字把蓝图定为「过程与范围的**唯一**事实源**」，**并逐字规定**「**两者不一致时，**本文档在过程与范围上优先，**主蓝图在架构意图上优先，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差异**」**；**它同时立了三条硬规矩**：**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提问或标出待决事项——**不要发明业务规则**」**「**没有被写进这里或某个已批准特性目录的需求，**就不要实现它**」**「**冻结范围；**只做当前阶段与该特性所规定的东西**」**
e.title_en: One file states which of two baselines wins when they disagree and forbids inventing business rules: a commercial property and casualty semantic system states verbatim that its blueprint is the only source of truth for process and scope, and specifies verbatim that where the two disagree the blueprint wins on process and scope while the master blueprint wins on architectural intent until an architecture decision record settles the difference, alongside three hard rules verbatim: if information is missing, ask questions or mark open decisions and do not invent business rules; if a requirement is not written here or in an approved feature folder, do not implement it; and no scope creep, building only what the current phase and feature specify
e.title_hk: **一份文件寫明「兩份基線衝突時誰贏」，並禁止發明業務規則**：一個商業財險語義系統**逐字把藍圖定為「過程與範圍的**唯一**事實源**」，**並逐字規定**「**兩者不一致時，**本文檔在過程與範圍上優先，**主藍圖在架構意圖上優先，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差異**」**；**它同時立了三條硬規矩**：**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提問或標出待決事項——**不要發明業務規則**」**「**沒有被寫進這裡或某個已批准特性目錄的需求，**就不要實現它**」**「**凍結範圍；**只做當前階段與該特性所規定的東西**」**
e.summary: 一份**面向商业财险的企业语义系统**（**★1**、**MIT**、仓库体量 2.2 MB、**实测 657 个文件**）：**逐字自述其功能为**「**一次性摄取文档、保留证据、**把「来源所声称的」与「企业所接受的」分开**，**并通过 360 视图、检索、图、API、代理与对话暴露受治理的**双时态知识**」**；**其最值得记的一处是它把**谁说了算**写死在文件里**——**逐字「**本文档是过程、范围与平台基线的**唯一**事实源**」**，**并**逐字规定两份基线冲突时的优先次序**（**过程与范围归本文档、**架构意图归主蓝图，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差异**）**；**第二处是它**禁止发明****——**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提问或标出待决事项——**不要发明业务规则**」**，**以及**逐字「**没有被写进这里或某个已批准特性目录的需求，**就不要实现它**」**与「**冻结范围**」**；**第三处是它把**跟踪表当成编译产物****（**逐字「**计划跟踪表必须始终同步。**把过期的跟踪表状态视为**流程缺陷**」**，**并**逐字「**绝不手工编辑生成的区域**」**）；**⚠️ 而其 README 逐字写着「**尚无运行时代码**」，**而实测 `engine/` 下有 **86 个 `.py` 文件**
e.summary_hk: 一份**面向商業財險的企業語義系統**（**★1**、**MIT**、體量 2.2 MB、**實測 657 個文件**）：**逐字自述其功能為**「**一次性攝取文檔、保留證據、**把「來源所聲稱的」與「企業所接受的」分開**，**並通過 360 視圖、檢索、圖、API、代理與對話暴露受治理的**雙時態知識**」**；**其最值得記的一處是它把**誰說了算**寫死在文件裡**——**逐字「**本文檔是過程、範圍與平台基線的**唯一**事實源**」**，**並**逐字規定兩份基線衝突時的優先次序**（**過程與範圍歸本文檔、**架構意圖歸主藍圖，**直到一份 ADR 裁定差異**）**；**第二處是它**禁止發明****——**逐字「**如果信息缺失，就提問或標出待決事項——**不要發明業務規則**」**，**以及**逐字「**沒有被寫進這裡或某個已批准特性目錄的需求，**就不要實現它**」**與「**凍結範圍**」**；**第三處是它把**跟蹤表當成編譯產物****（**逐字「**計劃跟蹤表必須始終同步。**把過期的跟蹤表狀態視為**流程缺陷**」**，**並**逐字「**絕不手工編輯生成的區域**」**）；**⚠️ 而其 README 逐字寫著「**尚無運行時代碼**」，**而實測 `engine/` 下有 **86 個 `.py` 文件**
e.summary_en: An enterprise semantic system for commercial property and casualty insurance — 1 star under MIT, a 2.2 MB repository measured at 657 files — describing itself verbatim as ingesting documents once, preserving evidence, separating what sources claim from what the enterprise accepts, and exposing governed bitemporal knowledge through 360 views, search, a graph, APIs, agents and conversation. **Its most notable feature is that who decides is written into the file**: verbatim, the document is the only source of truth for process, scope and platform baselines, and it specifies verbatim that where the two baselines disagree the document wins on process and scope while the master blueprint wins on architectural intent until an architecture decision record settles the difference. **The second is that it forbids invention**, verbatim instructing that if information is missing one should ask questions or mark open decisions and **not invent business rules**, alongside verbatim rules that a requirement not written in the document or an approved feature folder should not be implemented and that there must be no scope creep. **The third is that trackers are treated as compiled output**, verbatim requiring that planning trackers stay in sync at all times and that stale tracker state be treated as a process defect, and verbatim forbidding hand-editing of generated regions. ⚠️ **Its readme states verbatim that there is no runtime code yet, while measurement finds 86 Python files under the engine directory.**
e.body:
**nebula-insurance-brain**（仓库 `gajakannan/nebula-insurance-brain`）**是一份面向商业财险的企业语义系统**：**逐字自述为**「**a continuously evolving enterprise semantic system for commercial Property & Casualty insurance.**」**，**并逐字说明其功能是**「**一次性摄取文档、**保留证据、**把来源所声称的与企业所接受的**分开**，**并通过 360 视图、检索、图、API、代理与对话暴露**受治理的双时态知识**」**。**实测 **★1**、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件，**raw 探测 HTTP 200**；**GitHub 许可字段亦为 MIT**）、主语言 HTML、仓库体量 **2,274 KB**、**创建 2026-09-06**、最后推送 2026-09-11**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 3,440 字节**；**仓库实测共 **657 个文件、225 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 **`planning-mds/` 501 项**（**其中 **206 份 `.md`**、**111 份 `.yaml`**）、**`engine/` 149 项**（**108 个文件里 **86 个 `.py`**）、**`scripts/` 120 项**、**`neuron/` 46 项**（**30 个文件里 **20 个 `.py`**）、**`experience/` 24 项**（**20 个文件里 **8 个 `.tsx`**），**另有 `docker/`、`.github/`、`docs/`、`profiles/`、`.githooks/`、`config/`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「出处与占位：主张的依据，与尚未有依据的部分」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「谁说了算」写得最硬的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README、`planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md`、`DESCRIPTION` 式文件与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它把**两份基线冲突时谁赢**写死在文件里**——**其 `planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md` 逐字为**：**「**This document is the framework entry point and the **ONLY source of truth** for process, scope, and platform baselines.**」**，**并**另起一句逐字为**：**「**Where the two disagree, this document wins for process and scope and the master blueprint wins for architectural intent until an ADR settles the difference.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「唯一事实源」是对**过程与范围**说的，**而不是对全部**说的****——**⭐ 即**它**划定了自己权威的边界**（**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮主题**最成熟的一处**：**不是「一切以本文为准」，**而是**「这几种事以本文为准」****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **冲突时的裁决规则**被写成一句完整的条件句**（**谁赢、**赢在哪个维度、**以及**什么能推翻它**）**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **推翻机制是**一份 ADR**（**⭐ 即**分歧**有**唯一出口**，**而不是靠讨论**）；**④ ⭐⭐ **它同时说明**两份基线各自管什么**（**过程与范围**对**架构意图**）**——**⭐ 即**这不是优先级排序，**而是**分工****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它禁止发明，并把「没写下来的」当成边界**——**逐字四条**：**「**If information is missing, ask questions or mark open decisions — **do NOT invent business rules.**」**「**If a requirement is not written here or in an approved feature folder, **do not implement it.**」**「**If there is ambiguity, list questions and propose minimal default assumptions **labeled clearly.**」**「**No scope creep. Build only what is specified for the current phase and feature.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「不要发明业务规则」**是本条**最锋利的一句****（**⭐ 与第 348 轮 [[insurance-advisor-platform]] 的「把每一条编造的占位数字登记成一份文件」构成一对：**一个禁止发明，**一个把已发明的东西登记出来****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「未被写下的就不要实现」把**沉默**变成了**否定的授权****（**⭐ 即**默认答案是「不做」**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **含糊时的出口是**列问题 ＋ 明确标注的最小默认假设****（**⭐ 即**不是禁止假设，**而是**要求假设带标签****）；**④ ⭐⭐ **「冻结范围」随后紧跟一条**只做当前阶段与该特性**的限定**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它把计划跟踪表当成**编译产物**，并把过期当成缺陷**——**逐字为**：**「**Planning trackers must stay in sync at all times. **Treat stale tracker state as a process defect.**」**，**以及**「**`features/REGISTRY.md`、`features/ROADMAP.md` 与 `knowledge-graph/` 投影由 `scripts/kg/compile.py` **从 `kg-source/**` 分片编译得到**；**绝不手工编辑生成的区域**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「把过期的跟踪表状态视为**流程缺陷**」**——**⭐ 即**文档不同步**在这里是**可归责的缺陷**，**而不是疏忽****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **跟踪表是**生成的**，**不是手写的****（**⭐ 即**权威在 `kg-source/**` 分片，**而不在 REGISTRY 表格里**）**；**③ ⭐⭐ **它要求**在宣布任何规划或特性门通过之前**先跑校验器**（**逐字「Run the framework tracker and story validators against this repo before declaring any planning or feature gate complete」**）**。**④ ⭐⭐ **它的**过程**本身有三段，且每段有产出**——**逐字给出三段**（**A 产品经理模式：**产出特性目录（PRD、故事、STATUS、上手指南）；**B 架构师／技术负责人模式：**产出特性装配计划、ADR、API 与 schema 契约、kg-source 分片；**C 实现模式：**产出「生产级代码 ＋ 测试 ＋ 运行说明 ＋ 每个特性一份证据包」**）**——**⭐ 即**每一段的产出被逐条列出**，**故**「做到哪一步」可被核对**。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **它把框架**钉在一个提交上**，并要求**有意地推进**——**逐字给出框架名与提交哈希全值（`c218bf1776f509a30f71967a1ee79879caa9a000`，**日期 2026-09-07**）**，**并逐字要求**「**有意地推进这个钉版，**与 CI 门的工作流同步，**并把新提交记录在这里」**⭐⭐ **两处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **依赖被钉到具体提交**（**⭐ 即**「用哪个版本的框架」**是文档里的一行**）；**② ⭐⭐ **推进被要求**写回文档**（**⭐ 即**升级不是一个隐式动作**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其余可核实细节**：**① **它有一张**按路径分工的表**（**逐字为每个顶层目录列出用途与**归属角色**：产品经理、架构师、后端开发、AI 工程师、前端开发、质量工程师**）**；**② **实测其 `.md` 中**含 **7 份具名 ADR****（**逐字为**「大脑拥有语义」「PostgreSQL 是权威运行时存储」「一次性内容抽取」「源内容制品与解释分别版本化」「三平面知识模型」「FactSlot 定义规范语义身份」「完整双时态」**）**；**③ **它另有 `docs/agent-instructions.md`、`docs/plan-review-checklist.md`、`docs/framework-adoption.md` 与根级 `.nebula-project.yaml`**（**⭐ 即**面向 AI 代理的项目级说明与评审清单各有一份**）；**④ **它要求**每个克隆挂一次本地钩子**（**逐字 `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`**）**——**⭐ 即**知识图谱的**可复现性由钩子保证**；**⑤ **它把**知识图谱的源与产物分开**（**逐字 `kg-source/**` 是**撰写**的，**而 `knowledge-graph/*.yaml`、REGISTRY 与 ROADMAP 是**编译**的**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[clausegraph]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[kgqa-insurance-product]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]、[[risk-management-ontology]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **一处**声明与实测不一致**是本条最需要标注的地方，且由本词条实测发现****：**其 README 逐字写着**「**Status: Planning baseline. **No runtime code yet.**」**，**并**逐字写着**「**the repository remains a planning baseline with **no runtime implementation**」**；**而**实测其 tree 中 **`engine/` 下有 **86 个 `.py` 文件**（**108 个文件里**）、**`experience/` 下有 **8 个 `.tsx`**、**`neuron/` 下有 **20 个 `.py`**，**其中 `engine/apps/api/src/brain_api/` 下逐字含 `app.py`、`config.py`、`deps.py`、`errors.py` 等模块**，**且 `engine/apps/api/pyproject.toml` 存在**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **本词条**不主张**哪一方正确**（**⚠️ 可能的解释包括**README 未随代码更新、**或**作者把「脚手架」不计为「运行时代码」**；**⭐ 本词条**未读这些文件的内容，**故**不做判断**）；**② ⭐⭐ **但**两处说法**在同一份 README 里出现两次**（**状态行与其末段**），**故**不像是笔误**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **本词条**把这一处**与「禁止发明、要求同步」的蓝图并置****——**⭐ 即**该仓库的**过程纪律写得很硬**，**而**它自己的状态声明**恰好处在需要同步的位置上****（**⭐ 这是本轮主题**最直接的实例**：**声明也是一种需要维护的出处**）。**② ⚠️ **许可为 **MIT****（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE`，**raw 探测 HTTP 200**，GitHub 字段亦为 MIT；**⚠️ 本词条未读该文件内容**）**。**③ ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 Python 或 Node 依赖、未启动其 API 或前端、未跑任何测试、未跑 `compile.py`、未挂 `.githooks`、未打开任何文档之外的文件**；**故**本词条**不主张**其摄取、双时态治理或编译流程**按其所述工作**——**⭐ 本词条核实到的是**README 与 `BLUEPRINT.md` 的**逐字内容**，**以及**其经 tree 接口实测的文件结构与扩展名分布**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未读其 206 份 `.md` 中除 `BLUEPRINT.md` 之外的内容****（**⭐ 即**未核对**七份 ADR 的正文、**未核对**其特性目录与证据包是否确实存在**）**——**⭐ 这是本条目**最需要后续核实的一处**。**⑤ ⚠️ **★1**（**为本轮四条中关注度最高的一条**）、**fork 0**，**且**未核实作者背景**。**⑥ ⚠️ **创建与推送均在解冻窗口之内（2026-09-06／2026-09-11）****。**⑦ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/gajakannan/nebula-insurance-brain` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可 MIT、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；README 3,440 字节与 `planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md` 前 50 行经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；`LICENSE` 的存在经 raw 探测确认（HTTP 200）；**文件清单、各顶层目录项数与扩展名分布经 GitHub API tree 接口实测（657 个文件、225 个目录，`truncated` 为 false）**；**未克隆、未安装任何依赖、未运行任何脚本或测试、未启动任何服务、未挂任何钩子、未读 `BLUEPRINT.md` 之外的文档内容、未做任何网络观察**。

**nebula-insurance-brain**（倉庫 `gajakannan/nebula-insurance-brain`）**是一份面向商業財險的企業語義系統**：**逐字自述為**「**a continuously evolving enterprise semantic system for commercial Property & Casualty insurance.**」**，並逐字說明其功能是**「**一次性攝取文檔、**保留證據、**把來源所聲稱的與企業所接受的**分開**，**並通過 360 視圖、檢索、圖、API、代理與對話暴露**受治理的雙時態知識**」**。**實測 **★1**、fork 0、許可 **MIT**（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE`，raw 探測 HTTP 200；GitHub 許可字段亦為 MIT**）、主語言 HTML、體量 **2,274 KB**、**創建 2026-09-06**、最後推送 2026-09-11**（**創建與推送都在解凍窗口之內****）；**README 實測 3,440 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 657 個文件、225 個目錄**（**經 GitHub API tree 接口實測，`truncated` 為 false；含 `planning-mds/` 501 項（其中 206 份 .md、111 份 .yaml）、`engine/` 149 項（108 個文件裡 86 個 .py）、`scripts/` 120 項、`neuron/` 46 項（30 個文件裡 20 個 .py）、`experience/` 24 項（20 個文件裡 8 個 .tsx），另有 `docker/`、`.github/`、`docs/`、`profiles/`、`.githooks/`、`config/`**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「出處與佔位：主張的依據，與尚未有依據的部分」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本輪四條裡**把「誰說了算」寫得最硬的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README、`planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md` 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 把**兩份基線衝突時誰贏**寫死在文件裡**——`planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md` 逐字「**This document is the framework entry point and the ONLY source of truth for process, scope, and platform baselines.**」**，**並**另起一句逐字為**：**「**Where the two disagree, this document wins for process and scope and the master blueprint wins for architectural intent until an ADR settles the difference.**」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「唯一事實源」是對**過程與範圍**說的，而不是對全部**（它**劃定了自己權威的邊界**——不是「一切以本文為準」，而是「這幾種事以本文為準」）；**② ⭐⭐⭐衝突時的裁決規則寫成一句完整條件句**（誰贏、贏在哪個維度、什麼能推翻它）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐推翻機制是**一份 ADR****（分歧**有唯一出口**，而不是靠討論）；**④ ⭐⭐同時說明兩份基線各自管什麼**（過程與範圍對架構意圖——這不是優先級排序，而是**分工**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **禁止發明，並把「沒寫下來的」當成邊界**——逐字四條「**If information is missing, ask questions or mark open decisions — do NOT invent business rules.**」「**If a requirement is not written here or in an approved feature folder, do not implement it.**」「**If there is ambiguity, list questions and propose minimal default assumptions labeled clearly.**」「**No scope creep. Build only what is specified for the current phase and feature.**」**四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「不要發明業務規則」是最鋒利的一句**（與第 348 輪 insurance-advisor-platform 的「把每一條編造的佔位數字登記成一份文件」構成一对：一個禁止發明，一個把已發明的東西登記出來）；**② ⭐⭐⭐「未被寫下的就不要實現」把**沉默**變成**否定的授權****（默認答案是「不做」）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐含糊時的出口是**列問題＋明確標註的最小默認假設****（不是禁止假設，而是**要求假設帶標籤**）；**④ ⭐⭐「凍結範圍」隨後緊跟一條**只做當前階段與該特性**的限定**。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **把計劃跟蹤表當成**編譯產物**，並把過期當成缺陷**——逐字「**Planning trackers must stay in sync at all times. Treat stale tracker state as a process defect.**」，以及「`features/REGISTRY.md`、`features/ROADMAP.md` 與 `knowledge-graph/` 投影由 `scripts/kg/compile.py` **從 `kg-source/**` 分片編譯得到**；**絕不手工編輯生成的區域**」**三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐「把過期的跟蹤表狀態視為**流程缺陷**」**（文檔不同步在這裡是**可歸責的缺陷**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐跟蹤表是**生成的**而不是手寫的**（權威在 kg-source 分片）；**③ ⭐⭐要求在宣佈任何規劃或特性門通過之前先跑校驗器**。**④ ⭐⭐ **過程本身有三段，且每段有產出**——逐字三段（A 產品經理模式產出特性目錄；B 架構師／技術負責人模式產出特性裝配計劃、ADR、API 與 schema 契約、kg-source 分片；C 實現模式產出「生產級代碼＋測試＋運行說明＋每個特性一份證據包」）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **把框架**釘在一個提交上**，並要求**有意地推進**——逐字給出框架名與提交哈希全值（`c218bf1776f509a30f71967a1ee79879caa9a000`，日期 2026-09-07），並逐字要求「**有意地推進這個釘版，與 CI 門的工作流同步，並把新提交記錄在這裡」**兩處**：**① ⭐⭐依賴被釘到具體提交**（「用哪個版本的框架」是文檔裡的一行）；**② ⭐⭐推進被要求**寫回文檔****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 其餘**：有一張**按路徑分工的表**（逐字為每個頂層目錄列出用途與**歸屬角色**）；實測其 .md 中含 **7 份具名 ADR**（「大腦擁有語義」「PostgreSQL 是權威運行時存儲」「一次性內容抽取」「源內容製品與解釋分別版本化」「三平面知識模型」「FactSlot 定義規範語義身份」「完整雙時態」）；另有 `docs/agent-instructions.md`、`docs/plan-review-checklist.md`、`docs/framework-adoption.md` 與根級 `.nebula-project.yaml`；要求每個克隆掛一次本地鉤子（逐字 `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`——知識圖譜的**可復現性由鉤子保證**）；把**知識圖譜的源與產物分開**（`kg-source/**` 是**撰寫**的，而 `knowledge-graph/*.yaml`、REGISTRY 與 ROADMAP 是**編譯**的）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[clausegraph]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[kgqa-insurance-product]]、[[acord-mcp-architecture]]、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]、[[risk-management-ontology]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **一處**聲明與實測不一致**是本條最需要標注的地方，且由本詞條實測發現****：README 逐字寫著「**Status: Planning baseline. No runtime code yet.**」，並逐字寫著「**the repository remains a planning baseline with no runtime implementation**」；而實測其 tree 中 **`engine/` 下有 86 個 `.py` 文件**（108 個文件裡）、**`experience/` 下有 8 個 `.tsx`**、**`neuron/` 下有 20 個 `.py`**，其中 `engine/apps/api/src/brain_api/` 下逐字含 `app.py`、`config.py`、`deps.py`、`errors.py` 等模組，且 `engine/apps/api/pyproject.toml` 存在**三處**：**① ⭐⭐本詞條**不主张**哪一方正確**（⚠️ 可能的解釋包括 README 未隨代碼更新，或作者把「腳手架」不計為「運行時代碼」；⭐ 本詞條**未讀這些文件的內容**，故不做判斷）；**② ⭐⭐兩處說法**在同一份 README 裡出現兩次**（狀態行與其末段），故不像是筆誤；**③ ⭐⭐⭐本詞條**把這一處與「禁止發明、要求同步」的藍圖並置****——該倉庫的**過程紀律寫得很硬**，而它自己的狀態聲明**恰處在需要同步的位置上**（**聲明也是一種需要維護的出處**）。**② ⚠️ **許可為 MIT**（實測內含 LICENSE，raw 探測 HTTP 200，GitHub 字段亦為 MIT；⚠️ 未讀該文件內容）。**③ ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次沒有運行它的任何一步****——**未安裝 Python 或 Node 依賴、未啟動其 API 或前端、未跑任何測試、未跑 compile.py、未掛 .githooks、未打開輸入文檔之外的文件**；**故不主张**其攝取、雙時態治理或編譯流程按所述工作**。**④ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀其 206 份 `.md` 中除 `BLUEPRINT.md` 之外的內容****（未核對七份 ADR 的正文、未核對其特性目錄與證據包是否確實存在）——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**。**⑤ ⚠️ **★1（本輪關注度最高）、fork 0**，且**未核實作者背景**。**⑥ ⚠️ **創建與推送均在解凍窗口之內（2026-09-06／2026-09-11）****。**⑦ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：repo 於 2026-09-11 經倉庫檢索接口與 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 3,440 位元組與 `planning-mds/BLUEPRINT.md` 前 50 行經 raw 實測逐字核對；`LICENSE` 的存在經 raw 探測確認（HTTP 200）；**文件清單、各頂層目錄項數與擴展名分布經 GitHub API tree 接口實測（657 個文件、225 個目錄，`truncated` 為 false）**；**未克隆、未安裝任何依賴、未運行任何腳本或測試、未啟動任何服務、未掛任何鉤子、未讀 `BLUEPRINT.md` 之外的文檔內容、未做任何網絡觀察**。

**nebula-insurance-brain** (repository `gajakannan/nebula-insurance-brain`) **is an enterprise semantic system for commercial property and casualty insurance**, describing itself verbatim as a continuously evolving enterprise semantic system for commercial property and casualty insurance and stating its function verbatim as ingesting documents once, preserving evidence, **separating what sources claim from what the enterprise accepts**, and exposing governed bitemporal knowledge through 360 views, search, a graph, APIs, agents and conversation. **Measured 1 star, 0 forks, licence **MIT** with a licence file measurably present and answering 200 to a raw probe, the GitHub licence field agreeing, primary language HTML, a 2,274 KB repository, created 2026-09-06, last pushed 2026-09-11** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 3,440 bytes**; **the repository measures 657 files and 225 directories**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, holding a planning directory of five hundred and one entries including two hundred and six markdown files and a hundred and eleven YAML files, an engine directory of a hundred and forty-nine entries including eighty-six Python files, a scripts directory of a hundred and twenty, a neuron directory including twenty Python files, an experience directory including eight TypeScript React files, and docker, workflow, documentation, profile, hook and configuration directories. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **where a claim points and where the parts without a basis are written**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states who decides most firmly**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README, the blueprint and the measured tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It writes which of two baselines wins when they disagree into the file itself** — the blueprint states verbatim that the document is the framework entry point and **the only source of truth for process, scope and platform baselines**, **and states in a separate sentence, also verbatim, that where the two disagree this document wins for process and scope while the master blueprint wins for architectural intent until an architecture decision record settles the difference** ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the claim to be the only source of truth is made for process and scope rather than for everything, so the document bounds its own authority**, ⭐ **which this entry considers the most mature item in the round’s theme, since it is not everything here is authoritative but these particular things are**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the rule for disagreement is written as a complete conditional naming who wins, on which dimension, and what can overturn it**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the overturning mechanism is an architecture decision record, so a disagreement has exactly one exit rather than being settled by discussion**; **and ⭐⭐ it also says what each baseline governs, process and scope against architectural intent, which is a division of labour rather than a ranking**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It forbids invention and treats what is unwritten as a boundary** — four rules are given verbatim, that if information is missing one should ask questions or mark open decisions **and not invent business rules**, that a requirement not written in the document or in an approved feature folder **should not be implemented**, that against ambiguity one should list questions and propose minimal default assumptions **labeled clearly**, and that there should be **no scope creep**, building only what the current phase and feature specify ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the instruction not to invent business rules is the sharpest sentence here**, ⭐ **and forms a pair with the previous round’s entry that registers every invented placeholder number, one forbidding invention and the other listing what has already been invented**; ⭐⭐⭐ **not implementing what is unwritten converts silence into a negative authorisation, the default answer being no**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the exit from ambiguity is listing questions plus clearly labelled minimal default assumptions, so assumptions are not forbidden but must carry a label**; **and ⭐⭐ the freeze on scope is immediately followed by a limit to the current phase and feature**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ It treats planning trackers as compiled output and treats staleness as a defect** — verbatim, planning trackers must stay in sync at all times and stale tracker state is to be treated as **a process defect**, and verbatim the registry, the roadmap and the knowledge-graph projections are compiled from source shards, with generated regions never to be hand-edited ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **stale tracker state being a process defect makes documentation drift an attributable defect rather than an oversight**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the trackers are generated rather than written, so authority sits in the source shards**; **and ⭐⭐ validators must be run before declaring any planning or feature gate complete**. **④ ⭐⭐ The process itself has three phases, each with named outputs** — a product-manager mode producing feature folders, an architect mode producing assembly plans, decision records, API and schema contracts and knowledge-graph shards, and an implementation mode producing production-quality code with tests, run instructions and one evidence package per run. **⑤ ⭐⭐ It pins the framework to a specific commit and requires deliberate advancement** — the framework name and commit hash are given in full with a date, and the blueprint requires advancing the pin deliberately in step with the continuous-integration workflow and recording the new commit in the document ⭐⭐ **Two things**: ⭐⭐ **a dependency is pinned to a commit, so which version of the framework is in use is a line in the document**; **and ⭐⭐ advancing it must be written back**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Other details**: **a table assigns an owning role to each top-level path**, product manager, architect, backend developer, AI engineer, frontend developer and quality engineer; **measurement finds seven named decision records**, covering the brain owning semantics, the authoritative runtime store, one-time content extraction, separately versioned source artefacts and interpretations, a three-plane knowledge model, canonical semantic identity through a fact slot, and full bitemporality; **agent instructions, a plan review checklist, a framework adoption document and a project-level configuration file are all present**; **each clone must install a local hook**, ⭐ **so knowledge-graph reproducibility is enforced by a hook**; **and the source of the knowledge graph is separated from its product**, the source being authored and the projections and registry tables being compiled. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[clausegraph]], [[insurance-governance]], [[kgqa-insurance-product]], [[acord-mcp-architecture]], [[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]] and [[risk-management-ontology]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ A mismatch between a statement and measurement is the point needing most annotation here, and it was found by measuring**: **the readme states verbatim that the status is a planning baseline with no runtime code yet, and again verbatim that the repository remains a planning baseline with no runtime implementation, while measurement finds eighty-six Python files under the engine directory, eight TypeScript React files under the experience directory and twenty Python files under the neuron directory, with the API source directory containing modules named for the application, configuration, dependencies and errors, and a build configuration present** ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **this entry does not claim which side is right**, ⚠️ **possible explanations including a readme that has not been updated alongside the code, or scaffolding not being counted as runtime code**, ⭐ **and it read none of those files, so it draws no conclusion**; ⭐⭐ **the two statements appear twice in the same readme, in the status line and again near the end, so a typo seems unlikely**; **and ⭐⭐⭐ this entry places that mismatch beside the blueprint’s prohibition on invention and its demand for synchronicity**, ⭐ **since the repository’s process discipline is written very firmly while its own status statement sits exactly where synchronisation is required, making a statement a kind of citation that itself needs maintaining**. **② ⚠️ The licence is MIT**, ⚠️ **with its contents not read**. **③ ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **no Python or Node dependency installed, neither its API nor its front end started, no test run, no compilation script run, no hook installed and no file outside the readme and blueprint opened**; **so this entry does not claim its ingestion, its bitemporal governance or its compilation flow work as described**. **④ ⚠️⚠️ Of its two hundred and six markdown files, none beyond the blueprint was read**, ⭐ **so the bodies of the seven decision records and the existence of the feature folders and evidence packages were not checked** — ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**. **⑤ ⚠️ At 1 star, the highest-attention entry of this round, with no forks, the author’s background was not verified**. **⑥ ⚠️ Creation and push both fall inside the thaw window**. **⑦ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence, language, size and dates; the 3,440-byte readme and the first fifty lines of the blueprint were read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; the licence file’s existence was confirmed by a raw probe returning 200; **the file listing, per-directory counts and extension distribution were measured through the trees endpoint, 657 files and 225 directories with truncation false**; **nothing was cloned, no dependency was installed, no script or test was run, no service was started, no hook was installed, no documentation beyond the blueprint was read, and no network observation was made**.
